episode_title: Dage Discovers Why the Sunbeam Moves
episode_seed: Dage follows a warm sunbeam across the floor and discovers why it appears to move.
audience_fact: A sunbeam shifts across the floor because Earth rotates, changing the angle at which sunlight enters the window.
fact_label: Earth's rotation makes the sunbeam move.
optional_narration: As Earth turns, sunlight enters the window at a changing angle, so the bright patch slides across the floor.
